pt-BR.name: Quatro de Copas
pt-BR.intro: Um jovem de braços cruzados medita sob uma árvore, ignorando as três taças à frente enquanto uma mão oferece uma quarta. Apatia, contemplação e a oportunidade que passa despercebida.

hand-fourth-cup.title: A Mão e a Quarta Taça
hand-fourth-cup.description: Uma mão sai da nuvem oferecendo mais uma taça: a vida continua trazendo novas possibilidades, mesmo quando não estamos olhando para elas.

three-cups-ground.title: As Três Taças no Chão
three-cups-ground.description: Alinhadas à frente dele, as taças que já tem: o que foi dado se torna invisível quando a mente só quer o que falta.

crossed-arms.title: Os Braços Cruzados
crossed-arms.description: Postura fechada e olhar baixo: ele se protege do mundo. A introspecção ajuda, mas pode virar muro quando impede de receber.

tree.title: A Árvore
tree.description: Ele repousa ao pé de uma árvore robusta: o refúgio da pausa. É um tempo legítimo de reflexão, desde que não se transforme em estagnação.

en-US.name: Four of Cups
en-US.intro: A young man with crossed arms meditates under a tree, ignoring the three cups before him while a hand offers a fourth. Apathy, contemplation and the opportunity that goes unnoticed.

hand-fourth-cup.title: The Hand and the Fourth Cup
hand-fourth-cup.description: A hand emerges from a cloud offering one more cup: life keeps bringing new possibilities even when we are not looking.

three-cups-ground.title: The Three Cups on the Ground
three-cups-ground.description: Lined up before him, the cups he already has: what has been given becomes invisible when the mind only wants what is missing.

crossed-arms.title: The Crossed Arms
crossed-arms.description: A closed posture and lowered gaze: he shields himself from the world. Introspection helps, but it can become a wall when it prevents receiving.

tree.title: The Tree
tree.description: He rests at the foot of a sturdy tree: the refuge of pause. It is a legitimate time of reflection, so long as it does not turn into stagnation.

ja.name: カップの4
ja.intro: 腕を組んだ若者が木の下で瞑想し、目の前の三つの杯を気にせず、差し出される四つ目の杯にも気づきません。無関心、内省、見過ごされる好機です。

hand-fourth-cup.title: 手と四つ目の杯
hand-fourth-cup.description: 雲から現れた手が、もう一つ杯を差し出します。私たちが見ていなくても、人生は新しい可能性を運び続けています。

three-cups-ground.title: 地面の三つの杯
three-cups-ground.description: 彼の前に並ぶ、すでに持っている杯。心が足りないものだけを求めると、与えられたものは見えなくなります。

crossed-arms.title: 組んだ腕
crossed-arms.description: 閉じた姿勢と伏せた視線。彼は世間から身を守っています。内省は助けになりますが、受け取ることを妨げるなら壁になります。

tree.title: 木
tree.description: 彼は頑丈な木の根元で休んでいます。立ち止まる避難所です。停滞に変わらない限り、内省の正当な時間です。

he.name: ארבע של גביעים
he.intro: צעיר בזרועות שלובות מהרהר מתחת לעץ ומתעלם משלושת הגביעים שלפניו, בעוד יד מציעה לו רביעי. אדישות, התבוננות והזדמנות שחולפת בלי שמבחינים בה.

hand-fourth-cup.title: היד והגביע הרביעי
hand-fourth-cup.description: יד יוצאת מהענן ומציעה עוד גביע: החיים ממשיכים להביא אפשרויות חדשות גם כשאיננו מביטים בהן.

three-cups-ground.title: שלושת הגביעים על הקרקע
three-cups-ground.description: מסודרים לפניו, הגביעים שכבר יש לו: מה שניתן נעשה בלתי נראה כשהתודעה רוצה רק את מה שחסר.

crossed-arms.title: הזרועות השלובות
crossed-arms.description: יציבה סגורה ומבט מושפל: הוא מגן על עצמו מהעולם. התבוננות פנימית מועילה, אך הופכת לחומה כשהיא מונעת לקבל.

tree.title: העץ
tree.description: הוא נח למרגלות עץ איתן: מקלט ההפסקה. זו תקופה לגיטימית של הרהור, כל עוד היא לא הופכת לקיפאון.
